slot_scores.name: sequential_machine_order_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: You mentioned that the order of processing the three products on each machine should remain the same — does this mean we are choosing one single common sequence (e.g., 1-2-3) to apply to all three machines, or does it mean each machine can have its own sequence as long as the relative order is consistent across machines?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the common product sequence across machines, which is related to U6, but did not ask about the required machine routing order for each product (Machine 1 → Machine 2 → Machine 3) as specified in U5.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_processing_cycle
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you say "minimizing the total processing cycle," do you mean minimizing the time at which the last product finishes on Machine 3 (the makespan), or minimizing the sum of the completion times of all three products (total flow time)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for clarification of 'total processing cycle' and whether it means makespan, fully covering the hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each product is processed on all three machines in the fixed order Machine 1 → Machine 2 → Machine 3.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the required machine routing order for each product; this constraint was assumed without confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 hidden slot H1 (sequential machine order constraint) was only partially resolved; the required machine routing order was never confirmed.

summary: The agent clarified the objective and the common product sequence across machines, but failed to ask about the required machine routing order for each product, leaving a P0 hidden slot unresolved before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
